task: Improve Skim Deals, thread history and calendar event editing
intended_improvement: Put Inbox first, identify deal companies visually, reduce thread history clutter and support full event settings in a readable panel.

selection.reason: Reuse Skim Base tokens, fields, address input and existing event panel. Corpus search produced no compatible Svelte logo component. No external component code was installed.

inspection.component: Inspected logo load and fallback, history toggle, recurrence fields, reminders and colour selection.
inspection.screen: Captured Base dark and light at 1600x1000; event panel at 1200x800. Inspected settled fonts and message iframe.
inspection.journey: Playwright verifies navigation, loaded and failed logos, older-message focus, create/save/reopen and series-master scope. All fixtures are fictional.
inspection.product: Retains Base visual language and current Calendar views. Earlier 1.1.3 renders are unchanged; new states do not establish measured before/after gains.
